page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no printed marginal notes. Handwritten ink annotations appear in the left margin but are not printed text. Running head at the top, beside the page number 140.

main_text.p: Albinouano. Intentio: Vim fecisti. D. Non feci. Q.an fecerit? R. Quia vim facere, est manum alicuius oppugnandi caufa parare. At ego nōne candi cuiufquam, fed falutis meae tutandae caufa prefidiū habui. F. Imò vim facere est, quacūque de caufa homines armatos habere. D. Vim'ne is fecerit, qui fuae tantum falutis tuendae caufa, prefidiū armatorum hominum in foro habuerit. Est & Rabiria næ ftatus generis eiufdē. Lex est: Qui magiftratum populi R.violarit, perduellio judicator. C. Rabirius cōsulibus ad arma vocantibus præftò fuit,

page.notes: The first line "Albinouano." is a full-width line without an indent, so it is treated as a continuation from the previous page. The running head is decorated and hard to read, so I could not confirm its words. Handwritten marks in the left margin (ink annotations, in a non-Latin script) are not transcribed, as they are not printed. The first "prefidiū" may carry a cedilla under the e (ę) that I could not make out with certainty; I have copied it as printed without it.
